chunks: With this chain of transmission, from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Is zakat due upon one who has received zakat?” He said: “As for one who has received zakat al-mal, then zakat al-fiṭrah is due upon him; but there is no zakat due on what he received, and no fiṭrah is due upon one who receives fiṭrah.”

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat; obligatory alms discussed here as a legal financial duty
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةَ: fiṭrah alms in the context of what is received or owed
key_terms.زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرَةِ: the alms of fiṭrah due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.زَكَاةَ الْمَالِ: the zakat due on wealth and property
key_terms.قَبِلَ: received or accepted, referring to taking zakat

ai.seo_question: Is zakat or zakat al-fiṭrah due on a person who receives zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith explains a legal ruling concerning a poor person who receives zakat. It distinguishes between receiving zakat al-mal, which does not itself become subject to zakat while zakat al-fiṭrah may still be due, and receiving fiṭrah, for which no fiṭrah is due upon the recipient.
